'''Sergase Gilbearn''' is an [[Andoran]] noble of a minor House.

== Appearance ==
She is small and slim. Her dark hair is touched with white.

== Activities ==
She enters [[Caemlyn]] quietly when [[Rand al'Thor]] disposes of Lord Gaebril. 

She is one of the nobles who have thrown their support behind [[Elayne Trakand]] and brought her armsmen to [[Caemlyn]].

When Elayne is captured by the [[Black Ajah]], she and her armsmen ride to aid [[Birgitte Silverbow]] in rescuing her.
